**Actaira 2.3.0, the model scanner. Product line archived.**

This is the last version of what Actaira was until September 2026: a scanner for
model artifacts (pickle, safetensors, serialization formats) with its evaluation
corpus and its fuzzing.

It worked, and it is all still here: the tree at this tag includes `evals/`,
`fuzz/`, `policies/` and the `inspect`, `formats`, `conformance`, `policy` and
`state` modules. If that is what you came for, this is your version, and
`pip install` from this tag still works.

**Two things changed after it, and they are separate.**

*The subject changed.* From 3.0.0 on this repository does something else:
change control over what coding agents can do in your repository. It is not an
evolution of the scanner. It is a different product that kept the evidence core
(signing, sealing, offline verification) and dropped the rest. The reasoning,
with the three alternatives rejected before landing there, is in
`docs/DESIGN.md` §11, design note D-269.

*The name changed.* From 3.0.0 the project is called **seamark**, and the
repository is `github.com/marcosmatalab/seamark`. `Actaira` is now a different
product by the same author - the AI Act platform - and two unrelated things
under one name is a confusion nobody outside can resolve. The one that moved is
this one, because it had not been published under its name yet.

**Nothing about this release moved.** The tag, its tree, its artifacts and this
page are what went out in September 2026, under the name it went out with. What
the rename means for you is only this: if you want the scanner, you want this
tag; if you want what the repository does now, you want `pip install seamark`.
